head: Uber robotaxi in Munich: free Momenta self-driving rides in the Uber app
dek: Since 18 November Uber riders in much of northern Munich, including the area around the Olympic Park, can be matched with a Momenta self-driving car when they order UberX, Electric or Comfort. It's the first time people in Germany can book an autonomous ride in the Uber app.
details: Rides are free during the pilot, and a trained safety operator rides in every car. Momenta holds a German approval for Level 4 testing on public roads. Uber and Momenta plan to grow the area to more of Munich step by step.
where: Northern Munich, Germany, Uber app, pilot since 18 November
means: If you take Uber in northern Munich, your next UberX, Electric or Comfort ride may be a self-driving car, at no cost while the pilot runs.
todo: Order a ride as usual in the Uber app; the source says riders register in the app and may then be matched with a robotaxi.
